name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, how does this look for the Holy Night Festival schedule?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte, the order of these documents is wrong.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Tagalong, what's the big idea trying to take a break when you haven't done anything?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, that won't be necessary. Please just sit quietly and watch.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because I can't have an amateur messing up the workplace.」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're like this even at home, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you done with your part-time job for today?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yup. I thought I'd check in on you before heading to training, Big Brother」

name: Macaron
message: 「Just wondering if you'd messed something up」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, could you please compile these documents?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your little sister is so generous, unlike a certain Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? What's that supposed to mean! Fine, I'll help, happy now?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, we still have work left over here」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. Let's have some tea and calm down\s07」

name: Macaron
message: 「Let's see, blah blah blah about the seiyasai...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Hey, Big Brother. What's the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's kind of like a festival held around Christmas」

name: Synn
message: 「With sparkly lights and everyone cheering 'yay, yay' and all that」

name: Ria
message: 「It's a little different, though I guess it's the same in that it's a fun festival」

name: Misa
message: 「Holy Night! It is a special night where lovers whisper words of love!」

name: Misa
message: 「When you picture a Christmas night adorned in snow, doesn't it put you in a solemn, dazzling, and fantastical mood?」

name: Synn
message: 「It means we get to eat a feast, right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now then, shall we head home too」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm gonna do a little training before heading back, so you guys go on ahead」

name: Synn
message: 「I can stick around with you if you want」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're on dinner duty today, big brother」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, try not to stay out too late」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if it'll be an extra-large portion again today……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you two take turns making dinner」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Whenever we try to do things together, we somehow end up fighting」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You two always push yourselves forward like, 'Me first, me first!'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And yet, you're only ever thinking about each other」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Coming from me, your childhood friend, there's no mistake about it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, maybe that's why you two actually get along so well……」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, wanna come over for dinner tonight?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, make sure you cook up something really delicious for them」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright! Today's curry is getting a massive veggie boost!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So the menu ain't changing after all, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「If you'd rather have Macaron's cooking, you don't have to eat mine, Paqy」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron always tells me my curry is delicious, after all~」

name: Synn
message: 「Experimenting with the seasoning and all makes it really rewarding to cook」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I mean, it IS good, sure, but……」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's nothin'. Let's hurry up and go home」

name: Macaron
message: 「...I wonder if Pasta's gonna be here soon」

name: Melphas
message: 「Do you have an important engagement with Miss Pasta?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Not at all. Watching over the princess's growth is also my duty, having been appointed as your overseer」

name: Macaron
message: 「I didn't ask you to do that, though...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Would it be safe to assume you've already tracked down Virus's whereabouts?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh, impressive as expected of the princess. Quite swift to act. However...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Did you come all the way here just to say that?」

name: Melphas
message: 「...I believe that impatience always invites counterproductive results」

name: Melphas
message: 「Is that so? Then please forgive my rudeness」

name: Melphas
message: 「However, should anything happen to you, Princess, the Chairman would surely be worried as well」

name: Melphas
message: 「There is no harm in proceeding with caution」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm trying my best so I don't make anyone worry anymore...」

name: Melphas
message: 「...I see. Was my advice uncalled for?」

name: Melphas
message: 「It seems there is no longer any time for hesitation, either」

name: Melphas
message: 「Because the sight of the princess devoted to her training is dazzlingly beautiful, much like that setting sun」

name: Melphas
message: 「I came to the conclusion that if I were to invite you, there is no time like the present」

name: Pasta
message: 「If you're gonna hit on girls, do it somewhere else, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's right, nya. Lord Virus says he'll meet with you, Macaron, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「No butt-in from you, Pasta-chan. We're gonna fight this on our own」

name: Synn
message: 「No way. Macaron still hasn't come back yet」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Right now, saving our starving selves should be top priority」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's probably just getting all worked up by herself anyway」

name: Synn
message: 「What if she's run into some kind of danger...」

name: Sally
message: 「Mako-chii will be fine. She's tough, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「What if she got caught up in some incident……」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't you mean she's the one causin' an incident?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's terrible! I'm her guardian, you know」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, your head's totally full of Mako-chii, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm still worried, so I'm going to go look for her for a bit」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll find her right away and come back」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Melphas-san. Why are you at our place?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Why, if it isn't the Student Council President. Lovely moon tonight, isn't it」

name: Melphas
message: 「Yes. Actually, there is an urgent matter I would like your cooperation with」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you in some kind of trouble? If there's anything I can do, I'd be glad to help, though……」

name: Melphas
message: 「Ooh, as expected of the Student Council President」

name: Melphas
message: 「The truth is, I would like you to help me search for the Princess's whereabouts」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron? Well, I was actually just about to go look for her myself」

name: Melphas
message: 「I have already searched this vicinity, yet I have been unable to pick up her trail」

name: Melphas
message: 「My apologies, President, but could I ask you to search starting from the coastal area?」

name: Sally
message: 「Well then, I'll search over that way~」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh? If it isn't Great Sage Paqy. Is something the matter?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You bastard... What are you planning to make Lord Synn do?」

name: Melphas
message: 「What he chooses to do is entirely up to the guildmaster himself, I believe」

name: Melphas
message: 「I am honored by your kind words」

name: Sally
message: 「Paqy, what're you doing? You're gonna get left behind!」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's why I told you so, nya...」

name: Virus
message: 「Ho... After fighting this much, you can still stand」

name: Macaron
message: 「O-Of course I can! Because I swore I'd definitely win!」

name: Virus
message: 「One who calls herself a Demon Lord in the face of Re-Crea...」

name: Virus
message: 「For all the expectations you raised, that was terribly anticlimactic」

name: Pasta
message: 「Macaron, that's enough already, nya. If you apologize now, he'll still forgive you, nya」

name: Virus
message: 「Yet you lack the strength to even be called a Demon Lord」

name: Virus
message: 「Pasta. I thought you of all people would bring someone with a bit more backbone」

name: Virus
message: 「Enough. Any more of this is a waste of time」

name: Virus
message: 「I'll search for a real Demon Lord worth fighting」

name: Macaron
message: 「What... are you planning to run away...?」

name: Virus
message: 「...You mean to stand up yet again」

name: Macaron
message: 「Something like this... is just a little... warm-up...」

name: Virus
message: 「What a pity. That spirit alone is truly a pity...」

name: Virus
message: 「Ho, quite devoted to its master. Well-trained indeed.」

name: Virus
message: 「Now there is nothing left to act as your shield」

name: Macaron
message: 「Everyone is my comrade...! Not shields or anything...」

name: Virus
message: 「Just as you wish, I shall ensure you never stand again」

name: Virus
message: 「Pasta, I have no business with you. Do not interfere in this battle!」

name: Virus
message: 「I will at least acknowledge your spirit for daring to challenge me」

name: Virus
message: 「However, while your swordsmanship is commendable, it is also a fact that your training was just slightly lacking」

name: Virus
message: 「Before your breath gives out, I'll rip that slender throat open」

name: Macaron
message: 「In the end, I couldn't... do anything...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If only I were stronger, much stronger...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If only I could have fought properly...」
I wrap my whole body tightly around her collapsing small frame, catching her.
I feel the warmth in my arms.
I engrave it in my heart: I will never let go.

name: Virus
message: 「To butt into a one-on-one duel... I'll take it that you're prepared for the consequences」

name: Synn
message: 「No matter what, I won't forgive anyone who hurts Macaron!」

name: Virus
message: 「My name is Virus. Let me hear yours」

name: Virus
message: 「Show me just how resolved you really are」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're no match for him, big brother...」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't just run away after someone dear to me was hurt」

name: Synn
message: 「...Even so, I have to do this」

name: Synn
message: 「After what he did, there's no way I can let it go. Besides...」

name: Synn
message: 「No matter who I'm up against, I'll definitely protect her!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay. We'll definitely make it back together」

name: Virus
message: 「Synn Sakura! Do you really have time to look away!」
With no time to brace myself, a threat closes in right before my eyes.
A single blow reverberates to the very core of my body--so this is the gap in our strength.
Just shielding Macaron took everything I had.
A sense of despair rears its head, trying to shatter my resolve.
Even so, I won't ever let him lay a finger on Macaron.
Even if my counterattacks can't reach him.
As long as I stay conscious, I'll block every last blow!

name: Virus
message: 「Don't go finishing up on me after just this much!」
This is all a desperate, last-ditch counterattack amounts to.
Being stuck purely on the defensive slowly grinds me down.

name: Virus
message: 「What happened to all that bravado from earlier!」
I feel chills. I feel dizzy. I feel like throwing up.
My hazy hope and chance at victory scatter like mist far in the distance.
Both my mind and body go numb and waver.

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother... This is reckless, run away...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hehe... Yeah, I really don't stand a chance...」
No matter what happens, I won't run away.
No matter how painful it gets, I won't give up.
No matter how strong the enemy is!
For an instant, my vision bursts and shatters.
From deep within my body, a scorching torrent surges up...
And by the time I realized it, the scenery of the world had changed...

name: Macaron
message: 「No way... Big brother has this much magic power...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That right there is the Demon Lord's true form」

name: Paqy
message: 「A fierce will to protect something called forth your true power」
Half of me wants to doubt it, yet the other half feels a reality I can't deny.
What resides within these hands is unmistakably pure, unadulterated power of destruction.
Unease and fulfillment writhe and mingle together at the same time.

name: Pasta
message: 「Incredible magic power, nya... It's on a whole different level than before, nya...」

name: Virus
message: 「Demon Lord! Oh, Demon Lord! At last, I have met you face-to-face!」

name: Virus
message: 「How long I have waited for this moment...」

name: Virus
message: 「Good, so good--I have finally encountered the legendary Demon Lord...」

name: Virus
message: 「However, not yet. It is still not enough...」

name: Virus
message: 「I hear that only when Re-Crea's energy reaches its absolute peak does the Demon Lord unleash his ultimate power」

name: Virus
message: 「What I truly desire to clash against is nothing less than that very power」

name: Virus
message: 「For that is my one and only supreme ambition」

name: Virus
message: 「Demon Lord Synn Sakura. I will put this battle on hold until that time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hey, don't just decide that on your own!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Lord Virus, nya! Wait for me, nyaa!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That bastard got scared stiff of your power, Lord Demon Lord」
The instant the tension leaves me, the heat drains from the core of my head.
It feels as though my expanded presence has shrunk down a size.

name: Paqy
message: 「Back to normal, huh... Looks like your power still ain't complete」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I can feel an afterglow unlike anything before...」

name: Synn
message: 「Like an unknown power is rising up from deep within my body...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, that's the Demon Lord's true power for ya」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Demon Lord's bloodline inherits and wields this power down through the generations」

name: Paqy
message: 「You gotta hurry up and master it」
Power enough to go toe-to-toe with that guy, Virus.
Should I really be the one holding something like that.
A truth I had kept hidden so I wouldn't hurt Macaron, and so I wouldn't get hurt myself.
Now that she knows, there's no turning back.
The resolution I kept putting off, telling myself not to touch it, not to think about it...
It bred contradictions in my actions, drove a wedge between the two of us, and finally unraveled like this.

name: Macaron
message: 「...I see. So that's how it is」

name: Macaron
message: 「I told you not to come over here!」

name: Macaron
message: 「You said you'd support me, didn't you...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Why does it have to be you, Big Brother......」

name: Synn
message: 「And I never got the chance to tell you......」

name: Macaron
message: 「You kept quiet on purpose. Just because you're the true Demon Lord......」

name: Macaron
message: 「You've been looking down on me this whole time, pretending to be nice......」

name: Paqy
message: 「Shorty, that's going a bit too far」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Demon Lord has always been struggling with this in his own way, you know?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're on the Demon Lord's side too, Great Sage......」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, I'm sorry for keeping it a secret. But......」

name: Macaron
message: 「You have the power I could never get no matter how hard I wished for it, Big Brother......」

name: Macaron
message: 「You can't change your bloodline no matter what you do......」

name: Macaron
message: 「Trying so hard without knowing any of that makes me look like an idiot......」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't even know what I was doing......」

name: Macaron
message: 「I just told you, apologizing won't change anything!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even I...... I know I'm just taking it out on you」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nothing good ever comes from holding grudges」

name: Macaron
message: 「You never once opened up to me about anything, Big Brother……」

name: Macaron
message: 「That just means…… you didn't trust me, doesn't it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's all I ever meant to you……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Turns out that's the only kind of relationship we ever had……」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't care what happens to you anymore, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't ever want to see your face again!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Awakening out of nowhere like that must've drained your stamina」

name: Paqy
message: 「You should probably take it easy for a bit」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't…… I have to go after Macaron……」

name: Synn
message: 「If I don't push myself now, when else am I supposed to」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I was only thinking about myself...」

name: Synn
message: 「In the end, I couldn't even bring myself to trust Macaron...」

name: Synn
message: 「I just didn't want to be hated, that's all...」

name: Synn
message: 「Acting like that, I ended up hurting her...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Thinking about yourself is totally normal, man」

name: Paqy
message: 「How's a guy who can't worry about himself supposed to worry about anyone else」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're gonna chase after Shorty, aren't ya! Pull yourself together!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Didn't find her along the way, huh」
I hope she made it back okay, though given how she looked...

name: Sally
message: 「Jeez, where did you go! Things were totally crazy a minute ago!」

name: Sally
message: 「Like, Mako-chi was super mad, you know」

name: Sally
message: 「But she packed her things while crying and ran off somewhere...」

name: Sally
message: 「And then she gave me this super scary glare, it was terrifying!」
Even though I want to run out right now and chase after Macaron.
Strength drains away on its own from every inch of my battered body.

name: Paqy
message: 「You seriously used up way too much stamina today」

name: Paqy
message: 「Get some proper rest for now, and worry about Squirt tomorrow」
My eyelids are heavy. My body is heavy. The depths of my heart are heavy.

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't sweat it. It's just a normal sibling fight, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「If it's you two, Demon Lord, you'll make up in no time」
If things were going to turn out like this, I really didn't need the Demon Lord's power after all.
What am I supposed to do with this power I can't even handle?
What can someone like me even do for Macaron...?
